title: Retrieval Mechanisms
summary: This module offers diverse strategies for retrieving and processing documents, encompassing example selection based on similarity, document compression and filtering using LLMs or external APIs, and advanced retrieval techniques like multi-query, multi-vector, and self-query retrieval.

nodes.label: User Query
nodes.title: User Input Query
nodes.description: The initial query provided by the user or system to initiate a retrieval process.

nodes.label: Raw Documents
nodes.title: Unprocessed Documents
nodes.description: A collection of raw, uncompressed, or unfiltered documents that serve as the source for retrieval or processing.

nodes.label: LLM Service
nodes.title: Large Language Model
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model used for tasks such as query generation, document extraction, or filtering decisions.

nodes.label: Vector Store
nodes.title: Vector Database
nodes.description: A database storing vector embeddings of documents or examples, enabling similarity searches.

nodes.label: Document Store
nodes.title: Document Storage
nodes.description: A storage mechanism for retrieving full parent documents, often by ID, after child chunks have been identified.

nodes.label: Cohere Rerank API
nodes.title: Cohere Reranking Service
nodes.description: An external API service provided by Cohere for reranking documents based on their relevance to a query.

nodes.label: Semantic Similarity Example Selector
nodes.title: Select Examples by Semantic Similarity
nodes.description: Selects a specified number of examples from a collection based on their semantic similarity to an input query, using a vector store.

nodes.label: Max Marginal Relevance Example Selector
nodes.title: Select Examples by Max Marginal Relevance
nodes.description: Selects diverse examples by optimizing for both relevance to the query and diversity among the selected examples, using Max Marginal Relevance (MMR).

nodes.label: LLM Chain Extractor
nodes.title: Extract Relevant Document Parts (LLM)
nodes.description: Utilizes an LLM chain to identify and extract only the most relevant sections or summaries from a set of documents based on a given query.

nodes.label: LLM Chain Filter
nodes.title: Filter Documents by Relevance (LLM)
nodes.description: Filters out irrelevant documents from a collection by using an LLM chain to assess each document's relevance to a specific query.

nodes.label: Cohere Rerank Compressor
nodes.title: Rerank Documents (Cohere API)
nodes.description: Reorders a list of documents based on their relevance to a query, leveraging the Cohere Rerank API to assign relevance scores.

nodes.label: Ensemble Retriever
nodes.title: Combine Multiple Retrievers (Rank Fusion)
nodes.description: Aggregates and re-ranks results from multiple underlying retrievers using a rank fusion algorithm, such as weighted reciprocal rank, to produce a consolidated list of documents.

nodes.label: Multi-Query Retriever
nodes.title: Generate & Retrieve with Multiple Queries
nodes.description: Transforms a single input query into multiple distinct queries using an LLM, then retrieves documents for each generated query and returns a unique union of all results.

nodes.label: Multi-Vector Retriever
nodes.title: Retrieve Parent Documents from Chunks
nodes.description: Performs similarity search on small, embedded document chunks in a vector store, then retrieves the corresponding full parent documents from a document store.

nodes.label: Self-Query Retriever
nodes.title: Construct & Execute Structured Queries
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to parse a natural language query into a structured query, which is then executed against a vector store to retrieve documents based on both semantic and metadata filters.

nodes.label: Retrieved Documents
nodes.title: Processed Documents Output
nodes.description: The final set of documents after being retrieved, compressed, filtered, or reranked by the various mechanisms.

nodes.label: Selected Examples
nodes.title: Selected Examples Output
nodes.description: A list of examples chosen based on similarity or relevance to the input query, typically used for few-shot prompting.

groups.label: Example Selection
groups.title: Example Selection Strategies
groups.description: Components for dynamically selecting relevant examples to improve prompt engineering, based on similarity or diversity.

groups.label: Document Processing
groups.title: Document Compression and Filtering
groups.description: Mechanisms to refine and optimize retrieved documents by extracting key information, filtering irrelevant content, or reranking based on relevance.

groups.label: Advanced Retrieval
groups.title: Advanced Retrieval Strategies
groups.description: Sophisticated retrieval techniques that combine multiple sources, generate varied queries, or use structured query construction for more effective document fetching.
